items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days only and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown across 59 sites; aggregate findings must not be assigned to individual sites. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and block public exposure/security-sensitive releases; permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions/configuration, deploy, add dependencies, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Attach dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve private launch gates; do not create duplicate telemetry or production work.
